ownership_inventory.notes: Topology and geometry are read by the reference solver. Mutation during solve is not part of the F-SI contract.

ownership_inventory.current_location: legacy checkpoint arrays/scalars read by headcalc and SoilWaterStateVar
ownership_inventory.notes: Classified by physical meaning, but ownership is explicitly outside F-SI. F-SI must not redefine their checkpoint semantics.

ownership_inventory.current_location: legacy module globals and headcalc arguments/results
ownership_inventory.target_owner: solver request boundary conditions/forcing and solver result flux outputs
ownership_inventory.notes: Direction is item-dependent in legacy code. F-SI01 records the seam; F-SI02 must make request versus result direction explicit without changing formulas.

ownership_inventory.current_location: headcalc locals or legacy result arrays
ownership_inventory.target_owner: hydraulic evaluation output or worker workspace
ownership_inventory.notes: Values are derived during evaluation. Persistence per logical column is not required solely for Newton execution.
Storage lifetime is per active solve attempt and must be reusable/poisonable independently of logical-column state.

ownership_inventory.current_location: automatic arrays in nested alternative_solver linear solve
ownership_inventory.notes: Band-system factorization/solve scratch must not become persistent column state.
The runtime type already contains most heavy HeadCalc scratch, but current headcalc uses only dkdh directly. F-SI03 should connect the remaining arrays without formula changes.

ownership_inventory.current_location: headcalc SAVE singleton used when optional worker argument is absent
ownership_inventory.target_owner: remove from reentrant production path; retain only behind an explicit legacy adapter if still required
ownership_inventory.notes: This is incompatible with strong reentrancy and must not remain on the common solver path.

ownership_inventory.target_owner: must be resolved before columns can safely share a worker
ownership_inventory.notes: These values survive calls and may affect legacy numerical/macropore behavior. Worker ownership alone is insufficient if semantics are column-history dependent.

ownership_inventory.target_owner: worker/job diagnostics or solver result diagnostics
ownership_inventory.notes: Diagnostics must not affect physics. Per-attempt reset and aggregation policy belongs to runtime/diagnostics contracts, not physical state.

ownership_inventory.target_owner: solver result retry advice plus F-KT/F-PM-owned attempt control
ownership_inventory.notes: F-SI may report convergence/retry advice but does not own temporal acceptance or transaction lifecycle.

ownership_inventory.current_location: macropore module state imported by headcalc
ownership_inventory.target_owner: macropore physics owner with explicit evaluation/provider interface into the solver
ownership_inventory.notes: F-SI must not silently reclassify or change macropore physics. Cross-call semantics require exact follow-up isolation.
The procedures may hide shared parameter dependencies. F-SI04 must expose an evaluation context without copying immutable parameter data per column.

headcalc_internal_storage_visibility.current_observation: headcalc is an external subroutine; its automatic local arrays are not directly addressable by other modules
headcalc_internal_storage_visibility.static_gate: scan all src/**/*.f90 for call headcalc, ctx%headcalc and legacy_worker references; unexpected files fail F-SI01 gate

worker_workspace_proof.derivation: a23bu_headcalc_scratch_t contains 9 arrays of length n, two arrays of length n+1, two logical arrays of length n and flunsatok(3); nested band solve adds a(n,3), a1(n,1), b(n), indx(n)
worker_workspace_proof.scaling_conclusion: heavy Newton/Jacobian/hydraulic scratch scales with active workers/jobs and active nodes, O(W*n), rather than logical columns, O(C*n), provided cross-call column history is kept out of reusable worker scratch
worker_workspace_proof.qualification_limit: this is an ownership/layout proof, not a performance benchmark and not a parallel-backend qualification

fkt_boundary.hard_rule: F-SI solve returns a candidate result and retry/convergence information; it never commits, rolls back or redefines temporal acceptance
fkt_boundary.shared_type_change_policy: No shared kernel type is changed in F-SI01. Any later required extension is first recorded as a minimal interface contract and coordinated with F-KT.
